title: Stats: free iStat Menus alternative
caption:
iStat Menus costs $11.99. Stats shows what your Mac is doing, free, right in your menu bar 📊

✅ Live CPU, GPU, memory, disk and network usage
✅ Battery, temperature sensors and Bluetooth devices
✅ Click any menu bar icon for a detailed popup
✅ No telemetry, 100% free

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Needs macOS 12 or later. Fan control is a legacy feature and is no longer maintained

Comment "STATS" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
